eps.o: Years before the fraud, the lies and the coverup, Sam and Caroline meet in New York. As their romance heats up, so does their appetite for risking it all.
The math is clear: Sam and Caroline must agree on their primary focus. A bachelorette party raises questions about the past and FTX's balance sheet.
Sam lies to Caroline and the team as a fledgling FTX faces an existential threat. Later in the Bahamas, one of his oldest friends discovers the truth.
As Sam pursues an endorsement from his idol, FTX faces a choice between ethics and survival. In 2022, a reporter puts Caroline under the microscope.
Sam and Caroline wonder: What if crossing the line isn't so bad? As Nishad weighs his options in the Bahamas, another player plots a risky chess move.
Sam's ex-best friend tells his side of the story. All aboard Trabucco's yacht for a tragic tale of rubber ducks, One Direction and broken hearts.
Sam and Caroline's bond is tested under crisis. When the press flocks to the Bahamas, it's time for some game theory, but real life isn't a math problem.
The feds pressure FTX's inner circle as wild rumors swirl. The crypto empire comes crashing down, but the $8B question looms: Who's going to prison?
